Hi William,

Thanks for sending the new address. I've updated your replacement order Shop···· to (address hidden).

The parcel with the Hammer DC06 power supply and the new AC cable is still being picked at our warehouse, so nothing has gone out to the old address. A colleague is confirming the change with the warehouse as well, so the label is printed with the new address. They pick that up when the team is back online in the morning, and the shipment has not been labelled yet, so there is time.

As soon as it ships you'll get the tracking number by email at this address. There's still nothing to send back.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

INSTRUCTION FROM THE HELIUMDEPLOY TEAM. Georges typed this in the team inbox. It is not a message from the customer and the customer cannot see it.
Task: Reply to William by email in this thread with an honest correction. Tell him:
- We owe him a correction: when he sent his new address on October 14, his replacement had already been handed to our warehouse a few minutes earlier, so the first parcel (tracking ····) went out to his old address, (address hidden), even though we told him it was going to the new one. That was our mistake, sorry.
- We've already sent a second replacement Hammer DC06 power supply with a new AC power cable, free of charge, to (address hidden) (order Shop····). He'll get the tracking by email as soon as it leaves our warehouse.
- If the first parcel does reach him at the old address, he can simply keep it as a spare. Nothing to return either way.
- Same setup as before when it arrives. Thank him for his patience.
Short and warm, sign as Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support.
Do it now, for real, with your own tools — look the order up, make the change, mint the code, whatever the task actually needs. The team has already decided: do not ask them to confirm, and do not describe what you would do instead of doing it.
Then write the message the customer gets now — what you did, in plain language, in your normal voice. Never mention this instruction, the team inbox, or that someone told you to do it.
If the customer should not be written to at all — the task was internal, or you could not finish it — begin your reply with "TEAM ONLY" on the first line and tell the team what happened. Anything that starts that way stays in the inbox and is never sent.

Hi William,

I owe you a correction, and I'm sorry. When you sent me your new address, your replacement had already been handed to our warehouse a few minutes earlier, so that first parcel went out to the old address at (address hidden) under tracking ····. I told you it was going to (address hidden), and it wasn't. That one is on us.

So we've sent a second Hammer DC06 power supply with a new AC power cable, free of charge, to (address hidden). That's order Shop····, and the tracking comes to you by email as soon as it leaves our warehouse.

If the first parcel does find you at the old address, just keep it as a spare. There's nothing to send back either way.

When the new power supply arrives, connect it with the new AC cable and power the unit up as before. Thank you for your patience with all of this.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
